title: concept
description: One architecture concept a model fingerprint can name: an attention mechanism, a positional encoding, a normalisation or an activation function.

category.description: which fingerprint field the concept explains

code.description: the value a model fingerprint carries for this concept (for example GQA, RoPE, silu)

aliases.description: other fingerprint values that mean the same concept

order.description: position of the concept inside its category

short_description.description: one line for tooltips and inline notes

example_models.description: names of the model families that use the concept
